Public task: find integer start times for jobs 0–3, in job order, with order/files empty. Durations are [4,3,1,4], starts bounded [0,26], finish = start + duration. Windows: job 0 [15,23], job 1 [7,16], job 2 [9,18], job 3 [0,10]. Machine assignments are [2,1,1,2]; same-machine intervals may touch but not overlap. Precedence: 3→1 lag 0; 1→2 lag 1; 2→0 lag 1, with start[b] ≥ finish[a] + lag. Inclusive linear bounds: [-2,-3,3,2] dot starts in [-15,-12]; [-3,3,0,-3] dot starts in [-41,-37]. No optimization objective. Stage 1 of 1; later requirements can require changes and a stage pass is provisional.
